name: Josou Kakusei Keikaku
source:
An unkind friend forced Tomoya to wear girls clothes, then "she" was penetrated.
It aroused a hidden feeling inside...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE117370.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
一个恶劣的朋友强迫智也穿上女装，随后，「她」遭到了插入。
这唤醒了内心深处隐藏的感受…

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE117370.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
